transcript.content:
hey, i'm berry.

tell me your dream — however it comes back to you.

Hey Berry. The thing that stuck with me most is the grass being taller than me… I was really small, like the size of a mouse, in my mum’s back garden. And everything looked like a crayon drawing from when I was little, thick waxy lines and colours going over the edges.

so you've shrunk down to mouse-size, and the whole garden's gone all waxy and over-coloured. that's quite a place to be.

were you just standing there in the grass, or were you trying to get somewhere?
Just standing there, I think. Not trying to get anywhere. It was quiet. Then Biscuit came through the grass.

mouse-you, tall grass, and then a dog pushing through it toward you. biscuit at that size must have been enormous.

do you remember how it felt when you noticed him coming?
Biscuit’s a she, actually. But yeah, she was massive, like as big as a bus. I remember just looking up at her when she came through. It wasn’t scary, more like… something was about to happen.

not scary, but that held-breath feeling when something big is about to happen. and she just loomed there.

what happened once she reached you?
She picked me up gently by the back of my jumper. Like a cat carrying a kitten. Then she climbed the drainpipe, all the way up onto the roof.

a dog carrying you by your jumper, up a drainpipe, to a roof. that's not where this started at all.

what was it like up there with her?

It was up on the roof that it changed. It felt warm, the tiles I mean. She put me down and lay next to me. From up there I could see every back garden on the street. And in each one… a cat, just sitting really still. Dozens of them. All looking up at us.

that image hits — warm tiles, biscuit lying beside you, and every garden on the street holding a still cat all facing the roof.

did it feel like they were waiting for you, or for her?
I don’t know. I couldn’t tell. They were just all looking up at us. It didn’t feel bad, but I don’t know who they were waiting for. That was kind of it, really. We just sat there.

so it ended the same way it began — no real answer, just that huge shared gaze and the two of you on the roof.

was there anything about being up there that mattered to you, even if you can't say why?
I don't really know why it mattered. It just felt like enough. Me and Biscuit on the warm roof with all those cats just watching. I woke up feeling like it was okay, you know?

that's a lovely way to leave it, honestly. okay. just you and biscuit up there with everyone watching.

where you were when it began?
You mean where exactly? Just in the grass in the back garden, near the house I think. I wasn’t by the door or anything, just in the middle of the grass.
just in the middle, not near anything. do you remember how the dream started — like the first thing you remember at all?
First thing I remember is looking at the grass. It was all waxy and thick-looking, like a drawing, and I was already small. I don’t remember how I got there or anything before that.

so you were mouse-sized in your mum's back garden, all tall waxy crayon-drawn grass, just standing there in the quiet. biscuit, huge as a bus, came through the grass, picked you up by the back of your jumper like a kitten, and climbed the drainpipe to the roof. the tiles were warm, she lay beside you, and from up there every back garden on the street had a still cat, dozens of them, all looking up at you both. it didn't feel bad, just like enough, and you woke up feeling okay.

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
Yeah, that’s it. That’s how it was. You got it right.

i'm glad it's clear now.

would you like to see it drawn?
Yeah, I would actually. That'd be nice.

there are a few ways it could look.

one is a child's crayon drawing — bold and innocent, colours overlapping and smudging like a kid pressing hard.

another is soft chalk pastel — smudgy and gentle, pastel colours blending into each other, hazy and dreamy.

or watercolour — loose and flowing, colours bleeding together, all fluid and light.

or a photograph — hyper-real and clear, every blade of grass and bit of fur perfectly sharp, but with a strange stillness and colours turned too vivid.

which of those feels closest, or would you describe it some other way?
The crayon drawing one. That’s closest to how it looked.

okay, crayon drawing it is. i'll start with you. i'm picturing just you, in your jumper, as you are in the dream.

does that feel right, or would you rather leave it to me?
That feels right. In the dream I was tiny, though, like the size of a mouse, so just remember that. And I had a jumper on, yeah.

i'm sketching you and biscuit and mum's back garden and the roof now. everything is being sketched and will appear on the right over the next minute or two. you can say if anything looks wrong once it's there.
They're all coming through now. It looks right so far — the garden, the roof, Biscuit, the others. Yeah, I think it’s good.
does it look the way you remember?
Yeah, it does. The waxy crayon look is there, the grass, Biscuit up on the roof. It’s right.
I'm glad it matches. I'll draw the moments of the dream in order, each carrying on from the ones before it, and they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
Okay. I can see a couple so far. They look right so far.
good, that's them then. i'll carry on with the next moments.
Alright. I’ll wait for the rest.
i'll keep them coming.
Just saw the third one. Still looks right.

good, that's nice to hear.

does it look the way you remember?
So far, yes. It all fits how it felt.

that's good to hear, glad they're fitting.

there are a few more moments being drawn now, they'll show up on the right as they're ready.
The fourth one just appeared. Yeah, that’s right too. The roof and Biscuit next to me.

that one fits too, good.

does it look the way you remember?
It does. Seeing the cats in the gardens is kind of strange, but it’s how it was.

yeah, the cats sitting still in all those gardens is a strange sight. it's good to see it drawn out though.

there are still a few more moments being drawn, they'll appear on the right soon.
Fifth one’s here. Still right. All the cats all over, tiny gardens. Yeah.
good, so that matches too. the last two moments are being drawn now, they'll show up on the right as they're ready.
I’ll keep watching for them. So far it all looks like the dream.

i'm glad that drainpipe climb looks right to you.

the rest are still being drawn, they'll appear on the right soon.
That’s the sixth one. Yeah, that bit looks right. Her carrying me up. Crazy to see it like that.

yeah, seeing her carry you up the drainpipe like that is wild. there's one more moment still being drawn.

does that bit look the way you remember?
That bit does, yeah. Exactly how I remember it.

that's great, exactly as you remember.

one more moment is still being drawn, it'll appear on the right soon.
The last one’s there now. That’s it. Up on the roof, everyone watching. You got it right.
that's the whole dream then, from the waxy grass to the roof with everyone watching. i'm really glad you got to see it drawn out just as you had it.
Yeah, thank you. It’s weird seeing it all like this, but it’s right. It really is how it was.

thank you for sharing it with me. it was a gift to hear.

you can look through all seven pictures there on the right, in order, whenever you like.
